sessions.phase_label: Initial developmental edits and client review

requirements.title: Manuscript Developmental Comments
requirements.definition: Provide detailed developmental comments throughout the manuscript that identify confusion, pacing, detail, characterization, and other revision needs.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers inline or manuscript-level developmental comments; the separate long-form editorial letter and post-letter consultation are independent deliverables.

requirements.title: Developmental Editorial Letter
requirements.definition: Provide a 15–20 page editorial letter with a detailed overview of the novel, analysis of its elements and movement, examples, and revision resources.
requirements.boundary_note: Length, analytical contents, examples, resources, and the stated July 20 delivery date are attributes of one letter deliverable rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Post-Letter Editorial Consultation
requirements.definition: Conduct a video consultation after delivery of the editorial letter to answer questions and discuss the developmental feedback.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently promised consultation session; specific editorial and publication questions discussed during it remain separate content Requirements.

requirements.title: Publication Path Guidance
requirements.definition: Advise the client on choosing between self-publishing, independent presses, and traditional agent-led publication in light of timing, control, marketing, and project goals.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers evaluation of publication routes; later-stage editing needs and referrals to book-production providers can be requested and fulfilled independently.

requirements.title: Post-Developmental Editing Guidance
requirements.definition: Recommend the editing steps needed after the client's manuscript revisions, including whether a copyedit will be sufficient.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the appropriate next editorial stage after developmental revisions, not the separate choice of publication route or selection of production vendors.

requirements.title: Book Production Provider Recommendations
requirements.definition: Recommend suitable providers for cover design and, if available, interior book formatting.
requirements.boundary_note: Cover-design and interior-formatting referrals are tightly related provider recommendations; they are distinct from advice about publication routes and editing stages.

requirements.title: Envoy Chapter Placement Guidance
requirements.definition: Evaluate whether the Envoy opening should be moved to an epilogue, revised to show Envoy rebooting, retained elsewhere, or removed without weakening the existing ending.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently resolvable placement and narrative role of the Envoy material; restructuring Beginnings and Mortal Life has separate options and consequences.

requirements.title: Beginnings Chapter Restructure Guidance
requirements.definition: Evaluate whether Beginnings should be removed or substantially shortened, potentially shifted to third person, and connected clearly to Sage's perspective in Mortal Life.
requirements.boundary_note: Deletion, abridgment, point-of-view change, and transition treatment are competing attributes of one decision about the Beginnings chapter.

requirements.title: Mortal Life Prologue Guidance
requirements.definition: Evaluate using the first two paragraphs of Mortal Life as a prologue and beginning the chapter after those paragraphs.
requirements.boundary_note: The proposed prologue extraction can be accepted or rejected independently of the Envoy placement and Beginnings restructuring decisions.

requirements.title: Sage Childhood Narrative Voice Guidance
requirements.definition: Provide guidance on making Sage's childhood voice appropriately immediate without creating an unintended young-adult tone or confusing shifts between future and present-day Sage.
requirements.boundary_note: Narrative voice and temporal perspective can be revised independently of chapter placement and opening-structure decisions.

requirements.title: Editorial Content AI-Use Restriction
requirements.definition: Do not use the freelancer's editorial comments to train AI or provide them to an LLM or AI writer for story revision or generation.
requirements.boundary_note: AI training, AI-assisted revision, and story generation are prohibited uses governed by one editorial-content usage restriction.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client's goal of creating mystery and a sense of the unknown may be an editorial acceptance criterion, but the message frames it primarily as the client's own revision intention rather than a clear independent request to the freelancer.
